reason: I only buy gummies or drinks because I hate swallowing pills, and this is 2 capsules every day. The lab testing is a good sign and my doctor did say my magnesium could be low, but I'd rather ask for a gummy or powder than force down capsules.
objection: Two capsules a day is a no for me, I don't do pills. Also the lab report is only useful if I can actually open it and see it matches my box.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or drink-mix version with the same tested dose and the same lab report on the page.
